description: This Java class 'ImmutableRequestPlaceholder' implements a placeholder for request-related data based on an AuthorizationContext. It provides methods to check support for certain names, retrieve a prefix, and resolve authorization subject identifiers from the context.

classes.name: ImmutableRequestPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that provides placeholder logic for request authorization context data, supporting resolution of subject IDs based on provided authorization context.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string 'request' associated with this placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list containing the supported names, specifically 'subjectId'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given name is supported by this placeholder.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the subject ID from the authorization context, if available.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class.
